description: Fetch one article of one EU act by CELEX and article number, with its full text including paragraphs and points. Given a base CELEX it follows the act's family to the CONSOLIDATED version in force and says so — the base text is history and usually not the law that applies today. For a REPEALED act it answers the note that the act is repealed (and by what) and then the article's text from the act's last version, tagged [ABROGATED] (charged as lookup_eu_article_historical, the document tier, which reads the same text directly). Example: celex '32016R0679', article '17'.
name: lookup_eu_article
